name: Image Space Fabric Visualization
aliases: Fabric-Like Tensor Field Visualization on Surfaces
definition: A method to visualize tensor fields on arbitrary non-self-intersecting surfaces by projecting tensor data into image space, advecting a noise texture along eigenvectors, and blending with lighting and edge information to create a fabric-like appearance.
summary: Image Space Fabric Visualization renders symmetric tensor fields on surfaces by advecting noise along eigenvectors in GPU framebuffer objects, creating a fabric-like appearance with real-time performance.
